text.en: The Macario Molina Memorial High School at Barangay Tambac, Municipality of Romblon, Province of Romblon, is hereby converted into a regular secondary school under the control and supervision of the national government through the Department of Education, Culture and Sports, to be known as the Macario Molina National High School.
The Secretary of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
